rationale:
I independently verified the interpretation and next-decision against the bound execution receipt, manifest, per-file validation and the eight returned aggregate outputs, keeping real-execution evidence distinct from the synthetic test and prior external evidence.

Execution authority/provenance. The real CPU run is evidenced by the execution manifest (program_sha256 f647c012…, cpu_only true, training false, source 8e042339…, run_id diagnostics-b203ee1ce27e909d9d78d44a), the execution receipt (provider sb-01M4CTVGT1CC1CSPY149KG94BK; binding 6c6e617a…; full before/after rehash of 728 input and 30 package files PASS; read-only mount control PASS with writable-data/package controls actively REJECTED_WRITABLE and terminated; native preflight PASS), and eight output files whose SHA256 match both the receipt file_sha256 and validation.json. validation.json binds source/spec 4956d0d1…/code ef1c1eb7…/plan 613bb59a…/input-contract 8c9a1eb9…/environment a995dca9… and reports all eight checks PASS. The synthetic-test receipt (a6dedf30…, schema scientific-program-synthetic/v1, PASS 10/10, real_data_execution=false) and the SAVED-identity package manifest are correctly NOT treated as proof of execution success; the interpretation explicitly separates them. The approved code/spec chain is intact: prior blockers F1 (synthetic FAIL), F2 (env/image mismatch), F3 (spec misstates receipt) were raised over two REVISE cycles and closed by an independent APPROVE (run_spec_review-3, findings=[]) bound to the exact v4 program; the finding-status index shows both closed. The interpretation preserves those original judgments and their author-time FAIL context rather than rewriting them, and limitations.md records author-time status as such.

Metric/statistic. I reconciled the load-bearing numbers to the original outputs: placement primary candidate_fusion_minus_tree Dice mean 0.04043807 [0.02796645,0.05423991] n=99 and lesion-F1 0.02599646 [-0.00278,0.0553]; all-group tree Dice 0.20630608 and the stratified means; components union_branch_n=0 and routing matrix [[0,0,1,0],[0,0,27,1],[0,0,48,2],[0,0,10,10]] (router inactive, correctly framed as inactive not equivalent); integrity 99 patients, folds 20/20/20/20/19, 297 mask checks, 99 cache recomputes, 1,188 table comparisons, max abs error 0, native-seg Dice 1.0; coverage mean 0.5838 [0.5679,0.6003] with all 99 under 0.9 and the ≥0.9 group empty; availability 5 dependencies/2 unresolved upstream; calibration common-support [0.9,1] observed fraction 0.54893. Environment pins (numpy 2.1.3/scipy 1.16.3/nibabel 5.4.2, Python 3.12) match the recorded native environment. Patient-run duration, cost, tokens and intervention time are honestly reported as unavailable rather than invented; the 16.09 s synthetic time is not presented as the patient run.

Test-set/leakage and privacy. Development-99 only via five nnU-Net fold receipts; no final-25/reserve-24 or fallback access; labels (lesion_full) are evaluation-only and never route or rank (router uses predicted tree ml only; confirmed in the approval review and availability audit). Outputs are aggregate-only with per-case token scrubbing; no per-patient material was used (registered per_patient lists empty) and none is in model context.

Communication and scope. interpretation.md opens with a ~140-word plain-language Summary (question, answer bounded to 99 exposed development patients, key numbers and main caveats) then Details, with no procedural/authorization boilerplate; contrary evidence (fusion detection penalty, union volume tradeoff, shared misses .671, dependent meta-tuning, no calibration promotion, inconclusive cached CNN, 69/30 exposure) is preserved and attributed; no causal/clinical/equivalence/novelty/untouched-test claim is made. investigator_next_decision.json is status=PROPOSAL_ONLY, proposed_action_type=stop with a concrete charter-connected action (stop the item6 branch; do not promote the router or specialist training), charter_basis citing the selected follow-up infarct-prediction charter, and blocker_ids=[] (correct, as this is a scientific stop, not a blocker_resolution). No reruns, post-hoc definition changes, or execution/spending authorizations are asserted. No unresolved finding remains for this interpretation stage.
